purpose: Teach: フェミニスト/思慮/恒常/親日/親睦/大局/同紙/領主

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、フェミニスト運動の戦後史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper on postwar feminist movements was interesting, Ren.
lines.style: Warm, observational. Gentle opening—not a quiz, but a conversation starter. Steady eye contact. The tone of a teacher who's read something that made her want to talk to the student about it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、宗教家の思慮深さの研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on the intellectual depth in religious philosophy.
lines.style: Careful, a bit hesitant. Not defensive, just wanting to be precise about what he actually wrote. Slight pause before answering, as if gathering his thoughts. Quiet conviction underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、生態系の恒常性研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your research on ecosystem homeostasis touched on something important.
lines.style: Reflective, measured. Not quite asking a question, but inviting him to continue. Slight lean forward. The kind of comment that gives permission for deeper thinking.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦前の親日派外国人を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I was studying foreign supporters of Japan in the prewar period.
lines.style: Direct but not rushed. He's settling into the rhythm now. Slight emphasis on 'prewar'—marking the specificity. Calm, focused.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地域コミュニティの親睦活動を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Community engagement and local networks—that's substantial work.
lines.style: Attentive, approving without being patronizing. She's noticed the breadth of his interests. Warm but professional. A nod of recognition in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、外交における大局観の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined diplomatic strategy and long-term vision in foreign relations.
lines.style: More confident now. He's found his footing in the conversation. Steadier pace. A touch of pride in the specificity, but not arrogance—just the relief of being understood.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、同紙のスクープ記事を研究で扱いましたね
lines.en: The investigative journalism in those publications—that was an interesting angle.
lines.style: Curious, pulling back slightly. Not correcting him, but gently noting a shift in direction. Thoughtful pause before speaking. The tone of someone genuinely interested in where he's going with this.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、中世領主の統治研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I was looking at how medieval feudal lords structured their governance.
lines.style: Final answer—a landing point. Calm, assured finish. No trailing uncertainty. The pace is steady and grounded. A sense of conclusion, but warmth still present.
